projects.title: CELLO Residences by Taraf
projects.type: Residential community; two towers and 387 apartments per RMJM 2024 release
projects.overview: CELLO is a residential development in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. Taraf's public project information covers a mix of studio, 1–3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, a swimming pool, gyms, recreation and landscaped spaces. RMJM's design release identifies two towers with 387 apartments.
myWork: Prepared and coordinated shop drawings with Revit and AutoCAD and checked against IFC design information.
Reviewed multidisciplinary clashes and interfaces using Navisworks, including structural and MEP-related issues.
Supported consultant and subcontractor coordination, RFIs, revisions, technical approvals and constructability checks.

projects.overview: TIMEZ by Danube is a high-rise residential project in Dubai Silicon Oasis. Its developer presents convertible studios and 1-bedroom layouts, with residential amenities. myWork: Managed material submittals, RFIs, technical correspondence and approval-tracking workflows.

Coordinated technical submissions and shop drawing checks with project models, suppliers and subcontractors.

projects.title: Haya Karima — Dar El Salam, Sohag
projects.developer: Presidential rural development initiative — Haya Karima
projects.design: Multiple public-sector stakeholders and engineering teams
projects.type: Health facilities, schools, and community infrastructure
projects.overview: Haya Karima (Decent Life) is a nationwide initiative to improve infrastructure and public services. Public reports on Dar El Salam, Sohag, described 113 planned projects in 2022, including sanitation, water, electricity, health units and service facilities. These are district-wide program figures, not work personally delivered by the engineer.
myWork: Participated in architectural technical office and site coordination for public facilities.
Reviewed architectural drawings, finishing details, material requirements and site quality.
Supported documentation, site follow-up, meetings, BOQ verification and quantity surveying.
CV reports involvement with 14 new health units and four renovation projects; this scope is from the CV, not independently verified by public reporting.
